description: Replace console.log/error/warn with structured logging throughout codebase (40+ occurrences), implement proper error tracking, and add log levels for production.
steps: Audit existing lib/logger.ts - it has a basic structured logger with redaction but is not used consistently.
Update lib/logger.ts to export convenient log(), error(), warn(), info() functions wrapping the existing log() implementation.
Replace console.error in all app/actions/*.ts files (12 files) with logger.error() from lib/logger.ts, preserving error context.

Replace console.error in services/*.ts (automation-service.ts line 183, call-service.ts line 167, import-service.ts lines 147,218, auth-service.ts lines 102-103) with logger.error() or logger.warn() as appropriate.
Replace console.log in lib/env.ts development startup messages (lines 144-153) with logger.info() guarded by isDevelopment.
Keep console.log in seed scripts (prisma/seed.ts, seed-demo.ts, bootstrap.ts) as they are CLI tools run manually.
Add LOG_LEVEL environment variable validation in lib/env.ts (already exists in schema).
Update lib/api.ts line 29 to use logger.error() instead of console.error.
Document logging best practices in CONTRIBUTING.md or ARCHITECTURE.md.
Test that logs are properly structured and redact sensitive fields (password, token, etc) per lib/logger.ts redaction logic.
acceptance_criteria: All console.error/warn/log in application code (app/, services/, lib/ excluding seed scripts) replaced with logger calls
Logs are structured JSON in production (verify with LOG_LEVEL=error NODE_ENV=production)
Sensitive fields (password, token) are redacted in logs
Development logs remain human-readable with colors/formatting
No breaking changes to existing functionality
verification: grep -r 'console\.(log|error|warn)' app/ services/ lib/ --exclude-dir=node_modules | wc -l should be 0 after changes (excluding lib/logger.ts, env.ts startup)
npm run test to ensure no regressions
Start app with LOG_LEVEL=debug and verify structured JSON output in logs
findings: 40+ console.* calls in application code. lib/logger.ts exists with structured logging and redaction but is unused. No centralized error tracking. Production logs would contain sensitive data without redaction. Error boundaries log to console instead of logger.
